faqs.title: FAQs
faqs.description: Start your adventure fully informed — check out our FAQs.

faqQuestions.one: What types of vehicles and activities do you offer?
faqQuestions.two: Do I need a driver’s license or prior experience to ride?
faqQuestions.four: What should I wear for the desert adventure?
faqQuestions.five: Are there age restrictions or health considerations?
faqQuestions.six: How do I book, and do I need to book in advance?
faqQuestions.seven: What is your cancellation and refund policy?
faqQuestions.eight: What safety measures do you have in place?
faqQuestions.nine: Can I bring my own camera or GoPro?
faqQuestions.ten: Are group bookings or private tours available?
faqQuestions.eleven: Do you provide transportation to the desert adventure site?
faqQuestions.twelve: What payment methods do you accept?
faqQuestions.thirteen: Do I need to sign a waiver before participating?
faqQuestions.fourteen: What documents do I need to bring with me?

faqAnswers.one: We offer ATVs, quad bikes, dune buggies, dirt bikes, and camel rides — providing thrilling off-road and traditional desert experiences.
faqAnswers.two: No driver’s license or prior experience is required. We provide full safety briefings and training before every ride.
faqAnswers.three: Yes, all tours are led by professional and experienced guides to ensure safety and maximize your desert adventure.
faqAnswers.four: We recommend comfortable, lightweight clothing, closed-toe shoes, sunscreen, sunglasses, and a hat for sun protection.
faqAnswers.five: Participants must meet minimum age and height requirements. Pregnant women and individuals with serious health issues are advised not to participate. Please inform us of any health concerns.
faqAnswers.six: Bookings can be made via our Website, Phone, Email, or WhatsApp. Advance booking is highly recommended, especially on weekends and holidays.
faqAnswers.seven: All bookings are final and non-refundable. Rescheduling may be possible in cases of bad weather or other unforeseen events.
faqAnswers.eight: We provide helmets, and safety gear, conduct safety briefings, and maintain all vehicles regularly for your protection.
faqAnswers.nine: Yes! Feel free to bring your own cameras to capture your adventure. Many guests use GoPro mounted on helmets or vehicles.
faqAnswers.ten: Yes, we offer customized packages for groups, corporate events, and special occasions. Contact us to plan your personalized desert experience.
faqAnswers.eleven: Yes, sometimes we offer pick-up and drop-off services from major hotels or designated locations for an additional fee. Please inquire at the time of booking to arrange transportation.
faqAnswers.twelve: We accept cash & major credit cards. You can also book your adventure through online mobile payments.
faqAnswers.thirteen: Yes, all participants are required to sign a waiver acknowledging the risks associated with the desert adventure activities.
faqAnswers.fourteen: You should bring a valid physical ID (such as a passport or Emirates ID) for identity verification at the time of booking or check-in. No driver’s license is required for riding our vehicles, but minors must be accompanied by a parent or guardian with proper ID.

mediaGallery.title: Media Gallery
mediaGallery.description: Capturing memories from the heart of the dunes because every photo tells a story and welcome to our gallery.
mediaGallery.paragrapgh: Step into the world of thrilling desert adventures through our gallery! From roaring rides across golden dunes to unforgettable moments under the open sky, our media collection captures the heart-pounding excitement, natural beauty, and pure joy of every journey. Whether it's a quad bike kicking up sand or a sunset silhouette on a camel’s back — these are the memories that make Dune Rush unforgettable.
